summary: You need EARTHSYS 10 before the degree (it does not count toward the 45 units), the seven core courses for 23 units with EARTHSYS 295 taken twice, 5 units of foundational coursework from the approved list, and 22 elective units approved by the MA director, which you move in by hand; the foundational units may also count as electives. At least 34 of the 45 units must be at the 200 level or above, and none below the 100 level. Every course must be letter graded when that option exists. You check by hand a course the MA Director and Director of Earth Systems approved for CR (it does not count toward the 45 units here), the 9-unit limit on independent study, and the 3.4 GPA.

program.why: Grading: "All courses for the M.A. degree must be taken for a letter grade when that option exists; courses not taken for a letter grade must be approved by the M.A. Director and Director of Earth Systems." An approved exception is a hand check.

totals.label: EARTHSYS 10 (prerequisite)
totals.why: "Earthsys 10 may not be counted towards the required 45 units. Students must complete Earthsys 10 before MA degree conferral."

totals.label: 34 units at the 200 level or above
totals.why: "At least 34 units of the student's course work for the M.A. must be at the 200-level or above."

totals.label: Courses below the 100 level
totals.why: "All remaining course work may be at the 100-level or above."

add.why: GPA: "A minimum overall GPA of 3.4 must be maintained."

asLkhuNZ-text.why: "A minimum of 45 units of course work and/or research credit (upon approval)" is the program minimum, and "At least 34 units of the student's course work for the M.A. must be at the 200-level or above. All remaining course work may be at the 100-level or above." are program totals. Left for a person: "Up to 9 units of independent study are allowed, 3 of which are fulfilled by the required capstone course, Earthsys 294." Independent study has no list across departments.

patch.name: At most 9 units of independent study, 3 of them EARTHSYS 294

HMSoaJdB.why: "Complete all seven core courses, for a total of 23 units" and "Earthsys 295 twice, for 1 unit each time". The per-course units (EARTHSYS 293 for 5 units total, 294 for 3) may take several enrollments, which count toward the 23-unit floor.

JTZ3nwh8.why: "Complete a minimum of 22 elective units. ... They must add up to a minimum of 22 units and be approved by the MA director." Electives "can be selected from virtually any Stanford department or program", so the student moves the approved courses in. The 45-unit total ("These courses may count towards the required 45 units of the MA") is the Bulletin's unit minimum; the cap of 9 units of independent study is not checked.

DGn7pKQ1.why: "All MA students are required to complete a minimum of 5 units of Earth Systems foundational coursework ... These courses may count towards the required 45 units of the MA, as electives, or may remain in their undergraduate career." They may also count as electives, so this rule shares them.
